items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I told her that I was getting it from Lena Horne's father, Teddy Horne, who lived in Pittsburgh.

ctx.x: Audience, yeah. No problem to get in. All you had to do was try to make a reservation, because the damn thing was so popular, you know, that...You know, we had a man in Harlem at one time Oscar Hammerstein, was like an official host. When people were coming...say if Teddy Horne, Lena's father, or some person like that...the Jones boys from Chicago...if they were coming to New York they would phone Oscar and say, 'Listen, we'll be in town Thursday through Sunday. Plan, make plans for us.' What he would do would be…
52nd Street was that way, wasn't it...up until...
